user.title: ZR Gas Login
user.description:
Choose a data source and authentication method.

Online (mp): SMS login (recommended, no packet capture needed) or token import.
Payment (pay): token import only (its SMS login endpoints are blocked server-side).

token.title: Token Import
token.description: Paste pre-obtained credentials (from API or packet capture). Required: Access Token and User ID.

captcha.title: Captcha
captcha.description:
1. {link_left}Click here to open the captcha image{link_right} (in a new tab)
2. Read the code and enter it below
3. Submit to send the SMS code

sms_code.title: SMS Code
sms_code.description: An SMS verification code has been sent to your phone. Enter it to finish login.

error.token_required: Access Token and User ID are required
error.sms_send_failed: Failed to send the code — check the captcha
error.invalid_sms_code: SMS code is wrong or expired
error.invalid_token: Authentication failed, please log in again

abort.already_configured: This mobile number is already configured for this data source

init.title: ZR Gas Options
init.description: Adjust refresh interval, balance alert, bill query range and tiered pricing

reauth_captcha.title: Re-authenticate - Captcha

reauth_token.description: The token for the payment data source has expired. SMS login is unavailable for this source — capture a fresh Access Token and User ID from the payment mini-program and paste them below.
